title: Decode Latest .sub (rtl_433)
description: Pulls the newest /ext/subghz/*.sub capture, converts to .ook, decodes via Kali rtl_433, and saves /ext/apps_data/zero2zero/rtl433_last.txt.
command: import os, pathlib; from z2z.subghz import parse_and_analyze_sub; raw = pathlib.Path('latest.sub').read_bytes(); rep = parse_and_analyze_sub(raw, use_rtl433=True); src = os.path.basename(os.environ.get('Z2Z_PULLED_REMOTE', 'latest.sub')); txt = f'File: {src}\n' + rep.format_compact(); pathlib.Path('rtl433_last.txt').write_text(txt + '\n'); print(txt)
